GUI tile with HTTP/WebSocket serving and event handling for frontend and cluster updates

# Purpose
This C file implements the `gui` tile for the Firedancer runtime. It starts an HTTP server, serves the pre-built frontend assets, and upgrades selected requests to WebSocket connections. The file also connects the GUI to the rest of the system by reading data from many input links and translating those fragments into GUI events. These events include plugin updates, replay status, leader schedule data, gossip data, repair data, shred data, snapshot updates, and microblock execution events.

The file also sets up tile memory, seccomp rules, file descriptor limits, and runtime state for the GUI. It loads the identity key and optional vote key, selects the frontend asset set by release channel, and initializes `fd_gui`, `fd_gui_peers`, `fd_http_server`, and `fd_clock`. The `stem` callbacks handle housekeeping, polling, fragment processing, and WebSocket traffic. In full-client mode, the tile also tracks bank and replay state so the GUI can show slot completion, vote state, and other network status data.
